scope: Strided triangle input, descriptor validation and full cook-to-stream owner lifetime.

validation.case_scope: Three tetrahedron inputs (word indices, halfword indices and nonindexed vertices) pass the concrete default-axis path: clean/weld, convex grouping, tree, bounds, edge flags, mass, NXS/MESH write, complete readback and cleanup. Readback has four vertices/faces, one convex group, four categories, mass 1/6 and exact cursor. Uses synthetic header version17 and private math bundles; this is not an independently captured native asset or gameplay acceptance. Optional descriptor callback, axis-plane option and invalid input paths remain source-reviewed. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
validation.private_constants: Existing private atan2, mass, power and bounds bundles; no private data is published.
